question: Gambhira, Dhali and Jatra are the famous dance forms of which state?
solution:
The correct answer is __**West Bengal**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Gambhira, Dhali and Jatra **are the famous dance forms of West Bengal.
 
• Shakti worshippers perform Gambhira, a sacred devotional dance.
 
• The dance is named after the Chandi Mandir - **Gambhira's dance** hall, which features a specifically built pavilion in front of the shrine for the dance.
 
• During the reign of Raja Pratapaditya, the **Dhali Dance **was born and evolved. The Dhali dance is done by two guys using cane shields and bamboo sticks as weapons.
 
• **Jatra Dance **is famous in West Bengal. Bibek (conscience) and Niyati (fear) are two figures who grab the audience's attention in this dance form (fate).
